Definition
[Focal point] 1. ch10:4.2A point $q$ is focal to $N\subset M$ if there are $p\in N$ and a geodesic $\gamma :[0,\ell ]\to M$ with $\gamma (0)=p$, $\gamma '(0)\perp T_pN$, and $\gamma (\ell )=q$, together with a nonzero Jacobi field satisfying the two conditions of section 3 and $J(\ell )=0$.
